request: Build a small Jac web app for splitting group expenses. A group has members; an expense has a payer, an amount in integer cents and a split: evenly, by exact amounts, or by shares. The page shows each member's balance and the shortest list of 'X pays Y' transfers that settles the group.
acceptance: Splitting 1000 cents evenly among 3 members gives 334, 333 and 333; shares always sum exactly to the expense.
An exact split whose parts do not sum to the expense amount is rejected.
For balances A +50, B -30, C -20, settling gives exactly B pays A 30 and C pays A 20; balances always sum to zero.
constraints: Use Jac 0.36.1 and a fullstack Jac app.
Keep the logic deterministic and independent of external APIs.

source.note: Requirements written in English from the project's feature description; no code or text copied. Only one feature slice is reproduced.
